scopeNote: Covers permits issued by the City of Atlanta. Addresses in unincorporated Fulton or DeKalb County file with the county instead.

permits.coverage: City of Atlanta building permits, about 34,000 records, updated daily. Covers residential and commercial work from first application through certificate of occupancy.

source.name: City of Atlanta GIS
source.currentRecordsNote: Permits are published by the Atlanta Office of Buildings and feed the city's Building Permit Tracker.
